sql: SELECT callee_name, callee_kind, COUNT(*) AS n, MIN(file) AS a_file FROM calls WHERE callee_crate = 'conductor-run' AND file NOT LIKE '%conductor-run/src/%' GROUP BY callee_name, callee_kind ORDER BY callee_name
SELECT callee_name, callee_kind, COUNT(*) AS n FROM refs WHERE callee_crate = 'conductor-run' AND file NOT LIKE '%conductor-run/src/%' GROUP BY callee_name, callee_kind ORDER BY callee_name
SELECT from_crate, to_crate FROM crate_edges WHERE from_crate IN ('conductor-cli','conductor-tauri','conductor-run','conductor-report') ORDER BY from_crate, to_crate

SELECT callee_name, caller_name, file, line FROM calls WHERE callee_crate = 'conductor-cli' AND callee_name IN ('lamp_code','paint','hold_line','envelope_caption','coverage_summary','stdout_color','stderr_color','coverage_table_styled','coverage_summary_styled','wire','latency','hint_for','exit_code','env_seed','load_all_scenarios') ORDER BY callee_name, file, line

SELECT callee_name, caller_name, file, line FROM calls WHERE (callee_name = 'civil_from_unix') OR (callee_name IN ('request','write_message','read_message') AND callee_file LIKE '%jsonrpc.rs') ORDER BY callee_name, file, line
SELECT name, kind, file FROM symbol WHERE crate = 'conductor-run' AND kind = 'module'

SELECT DISTINCT callee_name, callee_kind FROM refs WHERE callee_crate = 'conductor-run' AND callee_file LIKE '%conductor-run/src/%' AND file NOT LIKE '%conductor-run/src/%' ORDER BY callee_kind, callee_name

SELECT callee_name, file, COUNT(*) AS n FROM refs WHERE callee_crate = 'conductor-run' AND callee_file LIKE '%conductor-run/src/%' AND (file LIKE '%conductor-cli/%' OR file LIKE '%conductor-tauri/%') GROUP BY callee_name, file ORDER BY callee_name, file
